plan: OpenVibe.Exchange, remade (2026-11-06): every AI model, one account — live prices, speed and uptime from OpenVibe.AI, model pages with every offer, a three-model chat on the shared conversation UI, one OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoint, selling compute through Node, the uncensored tier with its floor, and AI in OpenVibe. Exchange v1 is retired: pages answer 410 with a pointer, tables read-only.
summary: OpenVibe.Exchange is the network's AI front. It reads OpenVibe.AI's public catalog and aggregate usage and renders: the home (popular now, cheapest per million, uncensored, community machines, live numbers), /models and /m/<org>/<model> (every offer with price in/out, measured p50/p95, uptime and data policy, a Try it box, curl and the SDK), /chat (one to three models side by side, system prompt, temperature, history in the account, on openvibe-shared/thread), /api, /sell (Node's offer to the network; what is not sold, said plainly), /uncensored (an 18+ confirmation on the account and the hard floor) and /ai (which products run which models, and the daily cost). Chat and Try it are ai.complete runs on the person's behalf (on_behalf_of) with the service's ai.run.create token. Exchange v1 (free/swap listings, passports, sandboxes, installs, offers) is retired: every v1 page answers 410 with a pointer, its JSON API answers 410 exchange.retired, and its tables stay read-only; its tests live in test/retired/.
works: A live home, model list and model page read from OpenVibe.AI's /api/v1/exchange/catalog: price in/out/cached per million, p50/p95, uptime, requests, context, data policy
Every offer that serves a model on one page, with BYOK and restricted capacity excluded and prepaid capacity shown as free
A Try it box on a model page (one ai.complete run on the person's own allowance) with curl and the OpenAI SDK line
/chat on openvibe-shared/thread: one to three models side by side, system prompt, temperature, history in the account, a daily allowance and the 18+ gate for an uncensored model
/api: the OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoint, model ids, keys from Network, aggregate usage by day
/sell: Node's offer-to-the-network flow, the dashboard's empty state, and what is not sold (personal plans, personal API keys)
/uncensored: sign-in, an 18+ confirmation stored on the account, the abliterated models and the hard floor
/ai: product → model usage and daily cost from usage_daily.requester
Exchange v1 retired: 410 on every v1 page and on /api/v1 with a pointer, tables read-only, no job or relay writes them
Account export/deletion covers the chats, chat messages and 18+ confirmation, and still covers the v1 rows
Menus and the Network launcher move Exchange into the AI neighbourhood, and Network grants it ai.run.create (ns ai.complete)
notYet: The Network grant write/revoke: v1 keeps the install as an Exchange record; network.grants.write and network.grants.revoke are proposed and not in contracts v0.229.0
A real sandbox: v1 is a manifest/passport dry run; executing a listing needs OpenVibe.Run and a run.sandbox.execute capability
Paid listings through Billing (v2): no intent, transfer, cashout, entitlement or usage call exists in v1
Reviews and mutual reviews; the listing page shows no reviews yet
A user report form and moderation queue beyond the fixed filter and staff hide
Open data/API listings, Rates and price comparisons (Zone/Services/Tools)
Skill swaps on a time bank, city free-stuff hubs, a community white-label exchange, and Inventory gifting
Developer-app/agent routes: an app token is recognised but no v1 route needs one
deployment: not deployed: the unit and nginx vhost are deploy/systemd/openvibe-exchange.service and deploy/nginx/openvibe.exchange.conf
